questions.question: Your background includes month-end GL close, manual journal entries, and accrual schedules at Ellwood Group. Walk me through how you would validate a monthly accrual from initial estimate through posting, reversal, and reconciliation.

This role requires maintaining lease accounting schedules, which is not specifically detailed in your experience. How would you get up to speed on the applicable US GAAP requirements and build controls to ensure the lease schedule is complete and accurate?

At George Washington University, you prepared budget-versus-actual reports and variance analysis. Describe a significant variance you identified: how did you investigate its drivers, validate the data, and communicate the conclusion?

How would you prepare a financial reporting package and flux analysis when a balance sheet or P&L account has changed materially from the prior month but the operational team cannot immediately explain the movement?

You reviewed invoices at Ellwood Group to distinguish capital fixed assets from expenses. How would you apply similar judgment to determine whether a payment should be expensed immediately, recorded as a prepaid and amortized, or capitalized?

This position requires month-end allocations and operational reporting for departments. Describe how you would select allocation drivers, document the methodology, and explain the resulting charges to department leaders who challenge them.
Tell me about the employee-evaluation process you developed at Ellwood Group. What problem were you addressing, how did you gain adoption, and what evidence showed that performance improved?

You have used Excel as well as systems such as Hyperion, PeopleSoft, Lawson, and QuickBooks Pro. Which intermediate or advanced Excel functions, tools, or controls would you use to reconcile a large rent or prepaid schedule and identify exceptions efficiently?

At George Washington University, you researched and resolved financial discrepancies, and at Sightseeing Tours of America you resolved billing discrepancies. Describe one investigation where the cause was unclear, including the stakeholders involved and the steps you took to reach resolution.

Much of your experience has been in temporary accounting roles across different industries. What motivates you to pursue this Senior Accountant role, and how would you establish productive working relationships with AP and operational departments during your first few close cycles?
